description: Inspect account-level or key-level EthersFlow usage metering, lane split (FAST_PATH vs CONSENSUS), per-model/family token & USD cost attribution, and invoice reconciliation totals using your single EthersFlow API key (zero provider keys required).

family.description: Optional model family filter (e.g. qwen, gpt-oss, nemotron).

from.description: Optional ISO-8601 start date or timestamp (e.g. 2026-11-01).

key_id.description: Optional specific key_id belonging to your account.

scope.description: Roll up across all keys in the account (default: account) or restrict to the calling key (key).

to.description: Optional ISO-8601 end date or timestamp.

name: get_account_usage
